title: Robot Stack
summary: A reusable Codex skill and companion pack for deploying small agent-built websites to GitHub, MongoDB, Google Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, and custom DNS.
description: Robot Stack is the deployment city: an opinionated skill package that gives coding agents a clear path from local web app to owned cloud infrastructure.

The README frames the stack around boring repeatability: validate local tools, guide one-time setup, store reusable config, deploy to Cloud Run with safe defaults, reconcile secrets and env vars, then verify the live service.
